text:
This was my first time here and I really enjoyed it. The place is beautiful and clean. All the staff are kind. I only deducted points from the person answering the phone at the counter. A patient requested a reschedule because it was necessary. It would be nice if they didn't nag or sarcastically respond. I met the same person who was commenting on this. I don't know if they've read it. Please improve. A kind-hearted person with a positive attitude will improve your tone.

Regarding the slow wait, I want to defend the doctor. He's attentive and thorough. He doesn't hold back or hesitate. He can complete the entire procedure in one day. If the patient is happy with it, there's no need to make multiple appointments like at other places.

It's okay to be slow; I can wait. The lines at other places are much longer than here. Thank you to the doctor and all the staff.
